legend: Morphology intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and Burkitt lymphoma, characterized by a diffuse proliferation of medium-sized to large cells with a few admixed small lymphocytes. The cellular morphology is variable, exhibiting more variation in nuclear size and nucleolar content than generally acceptable for Burkitt lymphoma (H&E stain) (<<31237>>). The cytomorphological detail is better appreciated in a Giemsa stain (<<31238>>). The neoplastic cells strongly express BCL2 (<<31240>>). MYC is variably expressed by the neoplastic cells (<<31241>>). The proliferative rate is generally (but not always) high, here showing a Ki-67 proliferation index of > 90% (<<31242>>). MYC may be expressed at low levels, here in < 10% of the neoplastic cells (<<31326>>).
source: Prof Stefano Lazzi, University of Siena
